tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List published Great Britain local authorities (359 areas across England, Wales and Scotland) with release IDs and capabilities.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search UK postcodes, rail/metro stations, streets or places to obtain coordinates and city_id.

tools.name: analyze_place
tools.description: Estimate people simultaneously present within 250 m, 500 m or 1 km of a Great Britain coordinate across 24 hours (typical weekday, weekend and bank holiday).

tools.name: score_site
tools.description: Full commercial site suitability score (0-100) & Pre-Lease Due Diligence Audit for a UK retail or hospitality trade: 7-day demand, timing, competitor headroom, transit access, street-level micro-location pitch, 2026 VOA Business Rates (Rateable Value, Zone A GBP/m2, Small Business Rate Relief), Foot

tools.name: rank_sites
tools.description: Shortlist top-ranked 1 km areas inside one UK council or borough for a business type.

tools.name: compare_places
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 Great Britain locations side by side using consistent release data.

tools.name: get_place_context
tools.description: Inspect nearby commercial context, 2026 VOA Business Rates (Rateable Value, Zone A GBP/m2, Small Business Rate Relief), competitors, flood/heritage constraints, EPC/MEES, affluence and road traffic for a UK coordinate.

tools.name: create_report
tools.description: Generate an exportable Markdown or CSV commercial brief for a UK location and return a temporary download URL.
